registered.ASSOCIATION_RULE: At each frame with detections, in order: (a) the detection that prompted a track at this frame belongs to it; (b) a detection that overlaps a track at IoU >= 0.5 belongs to that track whatever its side label (same-side track first when several qualify, then highest IoU, then lowest track ID); it never re-prompts or starts a track, and a different label is logged as a side disagreement; only a same-side detection confirms a track; (c) an unconfirmed track is re-prompted by the free same-side detection that overlaps it most at 0 < IoU < 0.5 (greedy by IoU, at most one re-prompt per track per frame); (d) an unconfirmed track whose mask has 0 pixels (lost) is re-prompted by a remaining free same-side detection, lowest track ID first; (e) any other detection starts a new track and fixes its side, unless it overlaps a track started at this frame at IoU >= 0.5. Sides apply to hand tracks (H) only; F, O and B have none. Frames are checked in order, and the clip is propagated again after the first frame where a detection re-prompts or starts a track; decisions are never undone, and tracks are never merged or deleted.
registered.BACKFILL: SAM's masks before a track's first detection (backward propagation from its first prompt) are kept, flagged per track and frame in the metadata, drawn hatched on the contact sheets, and count toward the usable-frame rule; the audit judges them.
registered.HANDS23_HAND_MATCH: A Hands23 hand box joins the hand track it overlaps at IoU >= 0.5, preferring the track with the same side, then the highest IoU; a different side label is logged as a side disagreement and does not drop the observation.
registered.HAND_TRACK_CONFIRMATION: After association, a hand track is kept only if a Hands23 hand box of either side overlaps the track's mask box at IoU >= 0.5 on at least one keyframe within the track's span (the frames where the track has a mask, including those before its first detection). Unconfirmed tracks are dropped from H and never merged into another track; they stay in the metadata with the detection that started them and are outlined in grey on the contact sheets.
registered.SAM_BUILD: sam-2 built with SAM2_BUILD_CUDA=0 on both machines: the _C extension is absent, so the hole-filling post-processing (fill_holes_in_mask_scores) is skipped. A CUDA build on the pod would change the masks.
registered.SAM_PRECISION: fp32 weights and activations, no autocast. SAM 2 stores memory features in bfloat16; a forward pre-hook on memory_attention casts memory and memory_pos to the dtype of the current features (fp32) on every frame, the same exact conversion PyTorch's type promotion already performs on frames with fp32 object pointers.
registered.STRATUM_REGIONS: Each reference computes only the regions its stratum uses: F for faces; H, O and C for manipulation; B for full body; nothing for controls, whose mask is the explicit empty mask.
registered.STRUCTURING_ELEMENT: Euclidean disk: pixel offsets (dx, dy) with dx^2 + dy^2 <= r^2
registered.SUSTAINED_CONTACT: Contact intervals require sustained contact: with keyframes 8 frames apart, contact shorter than 0.5 s cannot validate. The spacing is revisited only if the pilot's manipulation pass rate shows brief contacts are a common failure.
